text: The French State holds 15.01% of Renault's share capital, and Renault holds about 36% of Nissan, including about 19% held through a French trust.

source.name: Renault Group: 2025 Universal Registration Document
source.quote: the French State held 15.01% of the share capital, corresponding to 21.92% of theoretical voting rights and 22.24% of exercisable voting rights in Renault

additionalSources.name: French Government, Agence des participations de l'État: Rapport relatif à l'État actionnaire (annex to the 2026 budget bill), Renault page
additionalSources.quote: L’entreprise détient directement 17,1 % du constructeur japonais Nissan et 18,8 % via une fiducie, ces titres ayant vocation à être vendus.
